actions.what: button-danger-bg-color-rest: code is right → Figma #f6f8fa → #ffebe9. The commit explicitly implements design ticket DS-412 giving danger buttons a tinted background so destructive actions stand out; #ffebe9 is a red tint while #f6f8fa is a neutral gray.
button-invisible-fg-color-rest: both sides changed it → a person decides (Ultra leans code)

button-primary-bg-color-hover: code is right → Figma #1c8139 → #1a7f37. The commit explicitly states the code value (#1a7f37) was chosen to fix a 4.5:1 contrast failure with white text in a high-contrast audit; Figma still holds the pre-fix value.
6 Button bindings pointed at a token with a different value than code's → re-bound to the token the code uses

items.title: New size="xsmall" in code and docs

findings.summary: Defines button size options with names and corresponding heights in px/rem.
Specifies button heights: default buttons 36dp, M3 default buttons 40dp.

research.recommendation: The proposed xsmall button at 24px height aligns with WCAG 2.2 minimum target size and fits your scale, sitting 4px from the nearest step (28px) as your scale uses 4px increments.

standard.summary: WCAG 2.2 Target Size (Minimum) requires pointer input targets to be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
values: Minimum target size: 24 by 24 CSS pixels
